reason_not_in.cursor: Cursor has no SendMessage to pass a new rule to a running agent, and its hook input may have no transcript folder for the notes.

does: Each agent a chat starts gets the chat's live notes file, so new rules reach agents the chat would forget.

children.does: Where each chat's notes file is. {transcript_folder} is the folder of the chat's transcript, {session} its id, and ~/ the home folder.
An agent brief that does not name the chat's notes file is refused, and the reason gives the path.
Makes the notes file with a short header when it is missing.
One line when the notes file grows past 30 KB, then once for every 20 KB more. It never changes the file.
A brief that starts background work without saying to stay until it ends gets that line added.
Tells the chat that the stay line was added to its brief.
After a message to an agent that carries a new rule, reminds the sender to add it to the notes and pass it on.
